svg.text: The stricter the gate, the fewer errors get through
12 public datasets, 500 answers each, sorted by confidence. Let through more of them (go right) and more errors get in.
← stricter gate, more work for people · share of answers that run without a person · no gate →
Exact star rating of a review · 1-5
How to read the orange line:
at the ○ (gate at 0.9) 54% of the answers run
on their own and 1.1% of them are wrong.
At the right edge they all do: 16.6% wrong.
github.com/Running-Dolphins/jev-bench · one run, 20 Sept 2026 · public datasets
